text: {"status":"answered","answer":"For wire transfers, under Harbor Credit Union's Wire Transfer Policy (Rev 2026-02, for retail accounts): a domestic wire must be received and verified by 3:00 p.m. Eastern Time on a business day to go out the same business day; anything after that, or on a non-business day, goes out the next business day. International wires must be received and verified by 1:00 p.m. Eastern Time to be released the same business day (delivery to the beneficiary can then take one to five business days). Note: these cutoffs are for wires only \\u2014 the passages I have don't cover cutoffs for other transfer methods such as ACH or bill payments.","cited_chunk_ids":["wire_transfer_policy::layout::B_structure::0004","wire_transfer_policy::layout::B_structure::0000"],"reason":"The policy states same-day wire cutoff times for retail accounts, though only for wires."}
